主要内容: Rollins, Inc. (NYSE: ROL) announced on October 3, 2016, that it repurchased 416,230 shares of its $1 par value common stock during the third quarter of 2016 at a weighted average price of $27.77 per share. This brings the total number of shares repurchased year-to-date to 835,559. The company, a premier global consumer and commercial services company, provides pest control services and protection against termite damage, rodents, and insects to over two million customers across multiple regions. The repurchase activity reflects the company's ongoing strategy to return value to shareholders.
